component.name: Radial Keys
component.summary: Open a radial menu of actions with your mouse

description.p: Radial Keys opens a configurable eight-segment action menu and can run built-in actions or Python macros.

Radial Keys now provides four complete action profiles, user-created profiles, action descriptions on hover, and automatic deactivation while a full-screen window is active. Built-in desktop actions work through the host session in Flatpak.
